title: 第13章 忘了第14章 没睡好
content_zh:
“柳姐姐跟你在楼上都说了什么？”沈二问他。
安衍面不改色，“没什么。”
沈二不信，但又找不到证据，只好暂时作罢，“接下来往哪走？”
“出城，往北边走。”安衍说。
“北边会不会很冷？”沈二伸出手指掐算日子，“还有一个月就入冬了，北方肯定会更冷，要不要买点厚衣裳备着？”
安衍看了她一眼，“你现在都算是一个正经的修士了，还怕冷？”
对哦。
可沈二还是担心，“不行，万一天寒地冻，我体力不支受不住怎么办？至少得买件袄子备着。”
她一边说着，一边踏入街边的一家成衣铺子，不一会儿便抱出一团灰朴朴的棉袄。
安衍看着她，目光在她怀中的棉袄停了一瞬。
“就买这个？”
沈二心满意足地把棉袄塞进空间，闻言，她回道：“怎么了？它才要八十文，我还特意买大一号，后面长个了也能穿。”
安衍唇角动了下，想说什么，但最终还是没有开口。
现在的她比初见时那副半死不活的样子好了很多，就是没几件像样衣裳，身上这套还是上个驿站拿的。
出了城门，官道笔直向北延伸。两侧是收割后的农田，光秃秃的，偶尔有几只鸟落在田埂上，一有风吹草动就叽叽喳喳飞走。
一路走到天黑，二人坐在树下准备过夜。
晚风渐凉，息玄都冷得钻进秘境，沈二掏出棉袄盖在身上，棉袄厚实，很暖和。
就是有点大，她在店里试过，下摆拖到膝盖，袖子也长出一截，但这那家店里最便宜的，她还跟老板砍价砍到八十文。
不过大也有大的好处，后面风餐露宿的日子绝对少不了，这棉袄不但穿，还能当被子盖。
安衍坐在她身侧，闭着眼。

沈二偷偷瞄了眼他的衣裳，白色的，料子很好，但已经脏了，衣摆还沾着几点泥渍。
她忍不住开口：“安兄。”
“嗯。”他没睁眼，闷声回应道。
“你那兜里有没有换洗的衣裳？”
安衍睁开眼，视线与她对上，“有。”
沈二等了一会儿，没等到下文，斟酌了下，问：“那你怎么不换？”
“……”
安衍沉默片刻。
“忘了。”
沈二：“……”
她不知道该说什么了，转过头去，拿出那本行气秘籍，翻开，借着月光去看上面的字。
许是见她看得费劲，安衍从兜里掏出一颗拇指大小的珠子，递给她。
沈二接过，珠子入手微凉，散发出一团柔和的光芒，照亮书页。
“这是……夜明珠？”
“萤石。”安衍道，“不值钱。”
沈二点点头，借着光开始看书。这秘籍她几乎每天都会拿出来看看，上面的字她都认齐了。
“行气的口诀你不是都会了吗？怎么还要看？”安衍问她。
“会是会。”沈二懊恼，“就是不持久，也不知道为什么，我想着再自己摸索摸索。”
安衍伸出手，扣住她的手腕，手指搭在她的脉门上。
content_en:
"What did Sister Liu say to you upstairs?" Shen Er asked him.
An Yan's expression remained unchanged, "It's nothing."
Shen Er didn't believe it, but couldn't find any evidence, so he had to give up temporarily, "Where to go next?"
"Leave the city and go north." An Yan said.
"Will it be very cold in the north?" Shen Er stretched out his fingers to count the days. "Winter will start in one month. It will definitely be colder in the north. Do you want to buy some thick clothes to prepare?"
An Yan glanced at her and said, "You are considered a serious monk now, but you are still afraid of the cold?"
Yes.
But Shen Er was still worried, "No, what if it's freezing cold and I lose my strength and can't stand it? I have to at least buy a jacket to prepare."
As she spoke, she stepped into a clothing store on the street and soon took out a ball of gray cotton-padded jackets.
An Yan looked at her, his eyes paused for a moment on the cotton-padded jacket in her arms.
"Just buy this?"
Shen Er stuffed the cotton-padded jacket into the space with satisfaction. After hearing this, she replied: "What's wrong? It only costs 80 cents. I bought it in a larger size so that I can wear it even if I grow longer in the back."
An Yan's lips moved, wanting to say something, but in the end he didn't speak.
She is much better now than the half-dead look she had when we first met her, but she doesn't have many decent clothes, so she got the one she wore at the inn.
After leaving the city gate, the official road extends straight to the north. On both sides are harvested farmland, which is bare. Occasionally, a few birds will land on the ridges of the fields, and will chirp and fly away at the slightest sign of disturbance.
When it got dark, the two of them sat under a tree and prepared to spend the night.
The evening breeze was getting colder, and his breath was so cold that he slipped into the secret realm. Shen Er took out his cotton-padded jacket and covered himself with it. The cotton-padded jacket was thick and very warm.
It was just a bit big. She tried it on in the store, and the hem reached her knees and the sleeves grew a bit too long. But this was the cheapest one in that store, and she even bargained with the boss for eighty cents.
However, being big also has its advantages. Days of sleeping outdoors will definitely be inevitable later on. This cotton-padded jacket can not only be worn, but can also be used as a quilt.
Anyan sat beside her, eyes closed.
Shen Er secretly glanced at his clothes. They were white and made of good material, but they were already dirty, and there were still a few mud stains on the hem.
She couldn't help but say: "Brother An."
"Yeah." He responded in a muffled voice without opening his eyes.
"Do you have a change of clothes in your pocket?"
Anyan opened his eyes and met hers, "Yes."
Shen Er waited for a while, but before he could say anything else, he thought about it and asked, "Then why don't you change?"
"..."
Anyan was silent for a moment.
"Forgot."
Shen Er: "..."
She didn't know what to say anymore, so she turned her head, took out the secret book of qi movement, opened it, and read the words on it by the moonlight.
Seeing that she was struggling to read, An Yan took out a thumb-sized bead from his pocket and handed it to her.
Shen Er took it, the beads were slightly cool in his hands, and emitted a soft light, illuminating the pages of the book.
"This is... Night Pearl?"
"Fluorite." Anyan said, "It's not worth anything."
Shen Er nodded and started reading by the light. She would take out this secret book and read it almost every day, and she recognized all the words on it.
"Don't you know the mantras for promoting qi? Why do you still want to read them?" An Yan asked her.
"It will happen." Shen Er was annoyed, "It just won't last, and I don't know why. I want to explore on my own."
Anyan stretched out his hand, clasped her wrist, and placed his fingers on her pulse.
